items.statement: A protected night repositioning round with handover risk reassessment will lengthen the median interval between category 2 or worse injuries on wards 7A and 7B, including on nights worse than one nurse to seven.
items.rationale: Need is high after 41 injuries in a year; the change idea is supported by one uncontrolled report (c2) and the staffing association (c1); the interval measure suits rare events.
items.risks: Round completion may collapse on the worst nights.

items.statement: Adding touch-based skin assessment to the round will increase the proportion of injuries first found at category 1.
items.rationale: Targets the detection gap in darker skin (c4).
items.risks: More category 1 findings could look like worsening.

summary: h1 selected; h2 kept as a planned second change idea.
